cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: That workshop with the boards over the windows is opening again. Someone came in for a paper and said they're clearing it out. I've sent you the address.

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: The old owner was a family friend. My uncle used to go round the back there, taking care of a vein for him. He'd leave me in the shop, so I can tell you exactly where it is and almost nothing useful about it. Sorry.

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: There's a passage beside it. Looks like it belongs to the next place, but it goes through to the courtyard. He always went that way.

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: He stopped going, eventually. I don't know if it was the ground or his knees. He wasn't one for explaining either.
You mark the courtyard. Hakim sends one correction: the passage is on the left, looking from the road.
